{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Continuous Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request: {}

jobs:
  mypy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
      fail-fast: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: setup uv
        uses: yezz123/setup-uv@v4.1
        with:
          uv-venv: ".venv"

      - name: Cache uv dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/uv
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ matrix.python-version }}-n

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: uv sync --group lint --all-extras

      - name: Typecheck with mypy
        run: bash scripts/mypy.sh

  tests:

    name: test py${{ matrix.python-version }} on ${{ matrix.os }}

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}-latest


    strategy:

      matrix:

        python-version: [ "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]

        os: [ubuntu]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: setup UV
        uses: yezz123/setup-uv@v4.1
        with:
          uv-venv: ".venv"

      - name: Cache uv dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/uv
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ matrix.python-version }}-n

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: uv sync --group test --all-extras

      - name: Test with pytest - ${{ matrix.os }} - py${{ matrix.python-version }}
        run: bash scripts/test.sh
        env:
          CONTEXT: ${{ runner.os }}-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-with-deps

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage.xml

  # https://github.com/marketplace/actions/alls-green#why
  # used for branch protection checks
  check:
    if: always()

    needs: [mypy, tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Decide whether the needed jobs succeeded or failed
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs uv sync in both the mypy and tests matrix jobs on every run with no dependency cache, so dependencies are re-fetched repeatedly. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) is supported by measured experiment evidence showing roughly 9-10% elapsed-time savings from adding a dependency cache before installation, and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is present and a lockfile (uv.lock) exists to key the cache. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/uv, keyed on runner.os, matrix python-version, and hashFiles('uv.lock'), preserves all typecheck/test coverage and the required check job, adds no secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment steps, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
